verdict.rationale: GitBook documents auto translations that keep documentation current in multiple languages. Its customization docs also let the site UI match the content's language. No evidence says that navigation (sections, groups, page titles) is translated, or how per-language versions are published and switched, for example via content variants. missing for 10: explicit documentation of translated navigation/site structure, a documented per-language publishing/variant workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of the translation feature.

support.subject: As a technical writer, I publish my docs in multiple languages with translated navigation and content

citations.quote: Auto translations make it easy to keep your documentation up-to-date in multiple languages, with minimal manual effort.
match the user interface to the language of your content
